gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1356.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: An extension from the existing Hoi Fung Path commencing at approximately 60 m from the junction of Hoi Fung Path and Tung Tau Wan Road, running northerly and then turning east for a total distance of approximately 120 m and joining Stanley Link Road as shown coloured blue on Drawing No. HH3727. Proposed Name: HOI FUNG PATH. Chinese Version: 海風徑.

No. 1356.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: An extension from the existing Stanley Link Road commencing at approximately 80 m from the junction of Stanley Link Road and Stanley Beach Road, running southerly and then turning west for a total distance of approximately 180 m and joining Hoi Fung Path as shown coloured red on Drawing No. HH3727. Proposed Name: STANLEY LINK ROAD. Chinese Version: 赤柱連合道.
